paragraphs.source_en: On the sixteenth day of the fifth month of Keichō 3, Toyotomi Hideyoshi fell gravely ill. He could no longer eat, and the court physician said that the hard swelling in his chest was growing larger. Kita no Mandokoro hurried from Osaka and remained constantly at his bedside. At Fushimi Castle, even the women were convinced that Hideyoshi had little time left.

units.source_en: On the sixteenth day of the fifth month of Keichō 3, Toyotomi Hideyoshi fell gravely ill.
units.source_zh: 庆长三年五月十六，丰臣秀吉病重。

units.source_en: He could no longer eat, and the court physician said that the hard swelling in his chest was growing larger.
units.source_zh: 他已不能进食，太医说他胸口的硬块愈加肿大。

units.source_en: Kita no Mandokoro hurried from Osaka and remained constantly at his bedside.
units.source_zh: 北政所从大坂赶来，一刻不离守护在枕边。

units.source_en: At Fushimi Castle, even the women were convinced that Hideyoshi had little time left.
units.source_zh: 伏见城里，连女人们都深信秀吉已时日无多。

paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month, the imperial court held a grand sacred kagura ceremony to pray for Hideyoshi's recovery. On the seventh day of the seventh month, Kita no Mandokoro sent Kōzōsu to Sanbō-in with ten ingots of gold, asking the monks to pray for Hideyoshi's swift recovery.

paragraphs.source_en: Konomi leisurely surveyed the palace, redolent of lacquer and fresh timber, neither lavishing praise upon it nor showing any particular surprise.
